_comment: Where to look for jobs. Edit feeds/searches freely.
_minScoreComment: Cold applications must clear a HIGH bar (much stricter than inbound replies) so you only apply to strong automation matches, not spray-and-pray. Raise to be pickier, lower for more results.
_excludeTitleComment: Job titles containing any of these whole words are skipped before scoring (no application package), across all sources. Used to drop entry-level roles. Matched in the title only, so senior roles that merely mention these words in the description are kept.
_llmComment: LLM re-scoring + tailored cover letters via the local Claude CLI (claude -p). The LLM NEVER gates: keyword minScore/requireRole decide what gets a package; the LLM only ranks, explains, and writes the letter. Any CLI failure silently falls back to keyword-only packages. maxPerRun caps CLI calls per run.

djinni._comment: Public Djinni jobs board, read with a plain fetch (no login, no browser). Each search is a full jobs-search URL — copy them from your browser's filters. Use primary_keyword=QA+Automation or primary_keyword=QA (Manual) for categories, or all_keywords=TERM for free-text. fullDescription (default true) follows each job link for the complete text so scoring is accurate; set false to score on the listing snippet only.

jooble._comment: Jooble via its official API on the Ukrainian market (apiHost ua.jooble.org — every vacancy is applyable from Ukraine). Keys are market-bound: the FREE key from ua.jooble.org/api/about goes into the JOOBLE_API_KEY env var (set it in run-jobs.sh, which is gitignored — never put the key here). Each search is { keywords, location }: ''=all of Ukraine, 'віддалено'=remote only, or a city like 'Київ'. The score gate + excludeTitle still filter results.
jooble._minScoreComment: Per-source override of the global minScore. Jooble's API returns only short snippets, which score ~5-8 points lower than full descriptions, so it gets a lower bar.
jooble._excludeLocationComment: The UA market also lists relocation vacancies physically abroad. Jobs whose location contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are dropped before scoring.

workua._comment: Work.ua public jobs board, server-rendered — read with a plain fetch (no login, no browser). Each search is a full jobs-search URL, e.g. https://www.work.ua/jobs-<query>/ (copy from your browser). fullDescription (default true) follows each job link for the complete text.

robota._comment: Robota.ua sits behind Cloudflare, which hard-blocks headless Chrome — this source only yields results when jobs.mjs runs with HEADFUL=1 (it is skipped with a log hint otherwise). Fetched through the same Playwright browser as LinkedIn, no login needed. Each search is a full search URL, e.g. https://robota.ua/zapros/<query>/ukraine (copy from your browser). fullDescription (default true) opens each vacancy page for the complete text — slower, keep maxResults modest.

linkedin._comment: Scraping LinkedIn job search violates ToS and is more detectable. Kept modest: few results, polite delays. Set enabled=false to turn off.
